name: Singularity
summary: Singularity is a container platform for shared Linux systems and HPC clusters, where unprivileged users run containers packaged as single SIF files. The open-source project was renamed Apptainer and is part of the Linux Foundation; Sylabs maintained a separate SingularityCE fork. Hermes Agent lists it as one of its terminal backends.
facts: Apptainer, part of the Linux Foundation
Runs as unprivileged user, blocks privilege escalation
SingularityCE (Sylabs); 4.6.0 expected to be its last Sylabs release
goodFor: Running agents on HPC clusters and shared servers
Packaging an environment as one portable file
watchOut: Two forks under one name; SingularityCE development by Sylabs is ending
